scope: Timing-only cache levels and capacity; two-round empirical interpretation, not specification validation

capacity_estimates.evidence: 64 B random: round-2 medians at 32 KiB are 5.90625 and 6.4453125; round 1 is 6.7734375. At 36 KiB the median is 15.890625 TSC ticks/load. The 32 KiB / 1024-load control is 5.732421875.

64 B random: round-2 medians at 256 KiB are 18.0859375 and 16.2734375; round 1 is 18.46875. At 288 KiB the median is 28.3984375. The two 384 KiB primary-layout medians are 40.6328125 and 40.5546875. The 256 KiB / 1024-load control is 18.40625 TSC ticks/load.

capacity_estimates.interpretation: Three cache residency regions are visible, but the broad 4-8 MiB LLC transition depends on layout, run and time. This interval does not bound nominal physical capacity.

caveats: Other users had active benchmarks on the shared machine; no CPU reservation was made.

During two round-2 subprocess intervals, SMT sibling CPU 7 averaged 75.812% busy (384 KiB / 8 B random) and 97.945% busy (52 KiB / 64 B random). Those samples are retained; the 384 KiB compact control is not treated as an independent clean corroboration.
Involuntary context switches totaled 1079 in round 1 and 1619 in round 2; zero measured faults or voluntary switches in either round.
Between-run and within-run latency variation remains visible. Page and layout controls do not isolate a unique cause for LLC changes.
Empirical intervals are not statistical confidence intervals or vendor specifications. TSC ticks have not been validated as core cycles.
third_round: Not executed. The requested two-round protocol is complete. Optional bounded refinement of 32-36 KiB or 256-288 KiB would be needed only for narrower onset brackets or confirmation under quieter conditions; no unbounded LLC search is warranted.
